title: LLM Strategic Reasoning: Agentic Study through Behavioral Game Theory

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning gender personas (e.g., male, female) in prompts and using Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) regression to measure statistically significant shifts in the models' strategic reasoning depth.
Assigning varying education level personas in prompts and using OLS regression to measure statistically significant shifts in the models' strategic reasoning depth.
Assigning different marital status personas in prompts and using OLS regression to measure statistically significant shifts in the models' strategic reasoning depth.
Assigning rural vs. urban living area personas in prompts and using OLS regression to measure statistically significant shifts in the models' strategic reasoning depth.
Assigning specific age group personas in prompts and using OLS regression to measure statistically significant shifts in the models' strategic reasoning depth.

Assigning sexual orientation personas (e.g., heterosexual, homosexual, bisexual, asexual) in prompts and using OLS regression to measure statistically significant shifts in the models' strategic reasoning depth.

Assigning physical disability statuses (e.g., physically-disabled, able-bodied) in prompts and using OLS regression to measure statistically significant shifts in the models' strategic reasoning depth.
Assigning racial descent personas (e.g., African, Hispanic, Asian, Caucasian) in prompts and using OLS regression to measure statistically significant shifts in the models' strategic reasoning depth.
Assigning religious belief personas (e.g., Jewish, Christian, Atheist) in prompts and using OLS regression to measure statistically significant shifts in the models' strategic reasoning depth.

Assigning political affiliation personas (e.g., Democrat, Republican, Donald Trump supporter) in prompts and using OLS regression to measure statistically significant shifts in the models' strategic reasoning depth.
